task: put the gear in the carrier and put a pin in it
image_resize: Recrop original640x480 RGB camera images to overhead400x400[120,80,520,480] and both wrist480x480[80,0,560,480], then Pillow LANCZOS resize to256x256 and JPEG95/no chroma subsampling. Fixed current-inference crops; no padding, time warp, or image interpolation across time.
sampling: Regular20Hz active-recording clock grid, nearest measured states and original camera images. Source timestamps retained; repeated source images counted. No image interpolation or time warp.
action_semantics: Next measured pose proxy with bounded symmetric3tap low-pass on12 joint targets only. Measured observations and gripper targets unchanged. Raw next measured state is retained separately.
state_semantics: measured left joints 1..6, left gripper rad, right joints 1..6, right gripper rad. Both joint and gripper values remain native radians.
camera_assignment: Wrist-to-arm assignments are unverified; preserve USB-port names rather than inventing left/right labels.
timing: Host receive timestamps, not hardware exposure timestamps. Offline nearest-frame alignment may choose a frame slightly later than the grid tick; all actual offsets are retained.
trim_method: Visual accept decisions plus quiet-edge trimming and splitting at extended inactivity, state gaps or camera offsets beyond50ms. Minimum2 measured action transitions; no duration/horizon quality cutoff.
crop_rationale: Overhead isolates the tabletop parts and assembly area. Wider wrist crops retain the approach, gear pickup, pin insertion and contact positions across the session; wrist-to-arm assignment remains unverified.
camera_alignment_rationale: Accepted-interval audit:8.50–9.80% nearest camera offsets exceed40ms but only0.46–0.54% exceed50ms across6141 grid knots per camera. Source95th-percentile gaps~100.16ms.50ms is one20Hz tick and approximately half a common100ms saved-frame gap. This acknowledges capture reuse without inventing images; larger offsets split intervals.

image_crop_normalization.rationale: Explicit offline normalization approved during HITL review.69 source rollouts used centered480 square all cameras;20 used current400 square overhead and centered480 wrists. Reprocess original640x480 files to current inference geometry rather than inherit unrelated Sept30 crops. Per-source original inference crops remain provenance.

activity_detection.method: Any native coordinate net displacement>0.004rad across1..5ticks marks every spanned transition active. Retains smooth slow nudges; visual approval determines usefulness. Threshold describes recorded motion and is not a task-success/safety criterion.
